## Secret/PII scan verdict: CLEAN

Scanned every commit since 2026-07-05 (`git log -p --since=2026-07-05`) plus the current tracked tree for: npm/GitHub/Slack/Sentry tokens, DB connection strings, private hostnames/IPs of home infra, non-public emails, .env contents, and `BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY`.

No real secrets, private IPs, home-infra hostnames, .env files, or connection-string credentials were found. Findings were all benign/intentional:
- `stefan@preu.at` + Impressum address (Stefan Preu, Steinbruch 5, 3250 Wieselburg) — public git author email AND legally-required public legal-notice contact (GDPR/Austrian Impressum), not leaked PII.
- `postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/pmweb` in README.md, src/db.ts, dist/db.js — clear placeholder/example for the DATABASE_URL env var, not a real credential.
- `ghp_…` UI placeholder in public/src/views/settings.ts GitHub PAT input — input hint, not a token.
- `you@example.com` / `colleague@example.com` — example placeholders.
- False-positive `xox` substring inside an integrity hash in extensions/pm-graph/package-lock.json.
- The hard-coded dev JWT literal `pm-web-dev-secret-change-in-prod` was already REMOVED by commit 77d1523 (replaced with a generated in-memory dev secret + production JWT_SECRET requirement). src/auth.ts verified clean.

## What was restored

`git checkout 6691d413^ -- .github/` (the targeted parent-checkout approach; a full `git revert --no-commit 6691d413` was attempted first but it also reverted CHANGELOG.md and removed the pm-web-y28b tracking item that 6691d413 legitimately added, so only the workflow files were restored).

Files restored verbatim from 6691d413^:
- .github/workflows/ci.yml
- .github/workflows/release.yml

## Workflow drift vs sibling (pm-todos)

Diffed restored pm-web workflows against /workspace/pm-todos/.github/workflows/. pm-web's restored workflows retain ALL fleet-wide fixes:
- non-main release guard ("Check release ref" step) — present
- push release tag/main AFTER npm publish — present
- npm-authoritative bun-lag fallback in bun-verify — present
- `npm publish --access public --provenance --ignore-scripts` + provenance-less fallback — present

Drift is intentional pm-web-specific or cosmetic (kept pm-web's own versions, nothing broken):
- release.yml cron `41 3` (pm-web) vs `23 3` (pm-todos) — staggered schedule, intentional.
- release.yml: pm-web uses npm scripts (`npm run changelog:full`/`changelog:check`/`release:notes`) and an inline `node -e` version-bump for manifest.json + src/index.ts; pm-todos calls `npx pm-changelog` directly with a hardcoded pm-todos item-url-base and `npm run release:update-version`. pm-web's pattern is correct for this repo.
- release.yml commit paths: pm-web commits `src/index.ts` + "Release pm-web ..."; pm-todos commits `dist`/`src`/`index.ts` conditionally + "Release ${repo} ...". pm-web-specific.
- release.yml GitHub release title "pm-web ..." vs `${{ github.event.repository.name }}`. pm-web-specific.
- ci.yml: cosmetic only (`pull_request: {}` vs `pull_request:`; step label "package graph" vs "package dependencies").

## Build/test results (branch fix/restore-release-pipeline-and-public-visibility)

- npm ci: 182 packages, 0 vulnerabilities, clean.
- npm run typecheck (graph+server+frontend): PASS.
- npm run build (graph+server+frontend): PASS.
- npm test: 48/48 tests PASS, 0 fail (no Postgres needed — legal-routes tests use an in-memory createApp).
- npm audit --omit=dev: 0 vulnerabilities (direct). NOTE: the `npm run audit:prod` wrapper exits non-zero locally due to a project-scoped `--allow-scripts` policy quirk; the underlying audit is clean.
- npm run pack:dry-run: 196 files, 2.1 MB, ok.
- npm run changelog:check: "Changelog is up to date".

## Branch

`fix/restore-release-pipeline-and-public-visibility` off main (commit 931c889). NOT pushed. Repo visibility / GitHub Actions re-enablement handled by the orchestrator (no repo settings changed here).

## Related
- Supersedes/re-fixes the 2026-07-06 regression introduced by 6691d413 (pm item pm-web-y28b, which closed by deleting the workflows + disabling Actions — the mistaken action this item reverses).
- Regression of pm-web-2xlv (2026-06-09 first restore via PR #7), which was the same class of fix for the earlier no-runner misapplication.
Restore pm-web release pipeline (mistaken runner removal 6691d413)

Regression of pm-web-2xlv (2026-06-09 first restore via PR #7). On 2026-07-06 commit 6691d413 re-deleted .github/workflows and the repo was re-privatized + Actions disabled; npm publishing stalled at 2026.6.14 while commits continued through 2026-07-10. Root cause: author confused pm-web (public self-hosted pm web-UI npm package needing daily releases) with pm-cli-companion (the only repo meant to be private/runner-less).

Secret/PII scan of the private window history (2026-07-05 onward) is CLEAN; .github/workflows/{ci,release}.yml restored from 6691d413^ on a feature branch (not pushed); restored workflows retain fleet-wide fixes (non-main guard, push tag/main after publish, npm-authoritative bun-lag fallback, --ignore-scripts); build, typecheck, tests, audit, pack, changelog:check all green; this pm item logs the scan verdict, restoration, drift, and build/test results.
